text_source: Individual dndtools feat pages (url on each entry).
text_source_note: dndtools labels each flaw's penalty as 'Benefit'. It is mapped to drawback here, and benefit is null because flaws have none. Text was cross-checked against the d20 SRD 3.5 Flaws page (https://cayzle.com/3Esrd/unearthedFlaws.html) and matches. Two dndtools text glitches were repaired: Feeble's markup-damaged '-2 penalty on Strength-' and Pathetic's broken ligature 'fl aw'. srd_name is the SRD spelling. The SRD gives no roleplaying text for flaws, so roleplaying_ideas is null.
category_rules: A player may select up to two flaws when creating a character. After 1st level a character cannot take additional flaws unless the game master allows it. Each flaw selected entitles the character to a bonus feat. Flaws are entirely negative in their impact on capabilities. (SRD, Unearthed Arcana Character Flaws.)

effects_schema.target: What is modified. Prefixes: skill:, skill_group:, skill_family:, save:, check:, ability_check:, ability_score:, ac, ac:dodge, attack:, damage:, initiative, miss_chance_roll:, speed:land_ft, hp_per_level, caster_level, darkvision_range_ft, literacy, condition_substitution:. 'chosen' means the player picks the target.
effects_schema.modifier: Signed number. Negative for penalties. null for set operations with no number.
effects_schema.condition: When the effect applies, or null if always.

feats.name: Feeble
feats.drawback: You take a -2 penalty on Strength-, Dexterity-, and Constitution-based ability checks and skill checks.

feats.name: Frail
feats.description: You are thin and weak of frame.
feats.drawback: Subtract 1 from the number of hit points you gain at each level. This flaw can reduce the number of hit points you gain to 0 (but not below).
feats.special: You must have a Constitution of 4 or higher to take this flaw.

drawback.note: Can reduce hit points gained to 0 but not below.

feats.name: Inattentive
feats.description: You are particularly unaware of your surroundings.
feats.drawback: You take a -4 penalty on Listen checks and Spot checks.

feats.name: Meagre Fortitude
feats.description: You are sickly and weak of stomach.
feats.drawback: You take a -3 penalty on Fortitude saves.

feats.name: Murky Eyed
feats.drawback: In combat, every time you attack an opponent that has concealment, roll your miss chance twice. If either or both results indicate that you miss, your attack fails.

drawback.condition: Attacking an opponent that has concealment
drawback.note: Roll the miss chance twice. If either or both results indicate a miss, the attack fails.

feats.name: Noncombatant
feats.description: You are relatively inept at melee combat.
feats.drawback: You take a -2 penalty on all melee attack rolls.

feats.name: Pathetic
feats.description: You are weaker in an attribute than you should be.
feats.drawback: Reduce one of your ability scores by 2.
feats.special: You cannot take this flaw if the total of your ability modifiers is 8 or higher.

feats.name: Poor Reflexes
feats.description: You often zig when you should have zagged.
feats.drawback: You take a -3 penalty on Reflex saves.

feats.name: Shaky
feats.description: You are relatively poor at ranged combat.
feats.drawback: You take a -2 penalty on all ranged attack rolls.

feats.name: Slow (flaw)
feats.drawback: Your base land speed is halved (round down to the nearest 5-foot interval).
feats.special: You must have a base land speed of at least 20 feet to take this flaw.

drawback.note: Round down to the nearest 5-foot interval.

feats.name: Unreactive
feats.description: You are slow to react to danger.
feats.drawback: You take a -6 penalty on initiative checks.

feats.name: Vulnerable
feats.description: You are not good at defending yourself.
feats.drawback: You take a -1 penalty to Armor Class.

feats.name: Weak Will
feats.description: You are highly suggestible and easily duped.
feats.drawback: You take a -3 penalty on Will saves.
